messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you feeling this week, and do you have any blood sugar readings to share?
Kind of annoyed honestly. My insurance denied my test strips last week so I've only been checking every few days. Got 138 and 152 fasting.

I've logged both of those readings — 138 and 152 fasting. I want to be upfront: insurance denials and claims are outside what I can help with. I don't have any way to contact your insurer or appeal on your behalf. Calling the member services number on your card, or asking your clinic to submit a medical necessity letter, are your best paths there.
Is there someone at Northline who handles that kind of thing? Like a care coordinator or something?

That's a fair question and I wish I had a better answer — that's just not something this service covers right now. A nurse can weigh in if something feels clinically off, but for insurance navigation you'd need to go through your clinic or insurer directly. I'll note in your record that you've had limited strip access this week so your care team has that context.
Alright. I'll call them tomorrow I guess. Thanks.
Good luck with that call — hope it gets sorted out quickly. I'll check in with you again next week.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
